package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"html"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Synthetic GET routes only. No app accounts, datastore, runtime or external assets.
type navigationFixture struct {
	host string
	css  []byte
	data PageNavigation
}

func (f navigationFixture) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; font-src data:; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
	if r.Host != f.host {
		http.Error(w, "invalid Host", 403)
		return
	}
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		w.Header().Set("Allow", "GET")
		http.Error(w, "GET required", 405)
		return
	}
	if len(r.RequestURI) > 2048 || r.URL.EscapedPath() != r.URL.Path {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", 400)
		return
	}
	if r.URL.Path == "/navigation.css" && r.URL.RawQuery == "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = w.Write(f.css)
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 2 || (parts[0] != "light" && parts[0] != "dark") || r.URL.Path != "/"+strings.Join(parts, "/") {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	theme, mode := parts[0], parts[1]
	if len(parts) == 3 && parts[2] == "choose" && mode == "get" {
		query, err := r.URL.Query(), r.ParseForm()
		if err != nil || len(query) != 1 || len(query["page_key"]) != 1 {
			http.Error(w, "one page_key required", 400)
			return
		}
		for _, item := range f.data.Items {
			if query.Get("page_key") == item.Key {
				http.Redirect(w, r, "/"+theme+"/get/"+item.Key, 303)
				return
			}
		}
		http.Error(w, "unknown page key", 400)
		return
	}
	if r.URL.RawQuery != "" {
		http.Error(w, "unexpected query", 400)
		return
	}
	data := f.data
	data.Items = append([]NavigationItem(nil), data.Items...)
	var rendered bytes.Buffer
	if mode == "original" || mode == "reference" {
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		if mode == "original" {
			rendered.WriteString(sourceExpected)
		} else {
			c, err := NewPageNavigationReference(data)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "invalid fixture", 500)
				return
			}
			if err := c.Render(r.Context(), &rendered); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "render failed", 500)
				return
			}
		}
	} else {
		if (mode != "get" && mode != "links") || len(parts) != 3 {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		data.CurrentKey = parts[2]
		data.NavLabel = "Workspace pages"
		data.SelectLabel = "Go to page"
		for i := range data.Items {
			data.Items[i].URL = "/" + theme + "/" + mode + "/" + data.Items[i].Key
		}
		c, err := NewPageNavigationLinks(data)
		if mode == "get" {
			c, err = NewPageNavigationGET(data, NavigationGET{Action: "/" + theme + "/get/choose", FieldName: "page_key", SubmitLabel: "Open page"})
		}
		if err != nil {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		if err := c.Render(r.Context(), &rendered); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "render failed", 500)
			return
		}
	}
	title := "P06 source-style reference"
	if mode == "get" || mode == "links" {
		for _, item := range data.Items {
			if item.Key == data.CurrentKey {
				title = "Workspace — " + item.Label
			}
		}
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	fmt.Fprintf(w, `<!doctype html><html lang="en" class="%s"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>%s</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/navigation.css"></head><body><main><h1>%s</h1><p>Private, synthetic page-navigation review. No application data.</p><div id="specimen" data-current="%s">`, theme, html.EscapeString(title), html.EscapeString(title), html.EscapeString(data.CurrentKey))
	_, _ = w.Write(rendered.Bytes())
	fmt.Fprint(w, "</div></main></body></html>")
}

func TestNavigationFixtureNativeHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	f := navigationFixture{host: "127.0.0.1:8767", data: fixtureNavigation(t)}
	for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
		for _, item := range f.data.Items {
			choose := "/" + theme + "/get/choose?page_key=" + item.Key
			r := httptest.NewRequest("GET", choose, nil)
			r.Host = f.host
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			f.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			want := "/" + theme + "/get/" + item.Key
			if w.Code != 303 || w.Header().Get("Location") != want {
				t.Fatal("native GET did not redirect to exact allowlisted route")
			}
			for _, mode := range []string{"get", "links"} {
				r = httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/"+theme+"/"+mode+"/"+item.Key, nil)
				r.Host = f.host
				w = httptest.NewRecorder()
				f.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				if w.Code != 200 || !strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), `data-current="`+item.Key+`"`) {
					t.Fatal("destination state mismatch")
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		method, url, host string
		code              int
	}{
		{"GET", "/light/get/choose", f.host, 400}, {"GET", "/light/get/choose?page_key=page-1&page_key=page-2", f.host, 400},
		{"GET", "/light/get/choose?page_key=page-1&unknown=x", f.host, 400}, {"GET", "/light/get/choose?page_key=%zz", f.host, 400},
		{"GET", "/light/get/choose?page_key=https://example.com", f.host, 400}, {"GET", "/light/get/unknown", f.host, 404},
		{"POST", "/light/get/choose?page_key=page-1", f.host, 405}, {"GET", "/light/get/page-1", "evil.example", 403},
		{"GET", "/light/get/page-1?secret=x", f.host, 400}, {"GET", "/light/get/%70age-1", f.host, 400},
	} {
		r := httptest.NewRequest(tc.method, tc.url, nil)
		r.Host = tc.host
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		f.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		if w.Code != tc.code || w.Header().Get("Location") != "" {
			t.Fatalf("request refusal: %s %s got %d", tc.method, tc.url, w.Code)
		}
	}
}

func TestServeNavigationPreview(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("APPKIT_P06_SERVE") != "1" {
		t.Skip("explicit local preview only")
	}
	css, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("APPKIT_P06_CSS"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	l, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	server := &http.Server{Handler: navigationFixture{host: l.Addr().String(), css: css, data: fixtureNavigation(t)}, ReadHeaderTimeout: 3 * time.Second, WriteTimeout: 5 * time.Second, MaxHeaderBytes: 16 << 10}
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- server.Serve(l) }()
	fmt.Printf("APPKIT_P06_URL=http://%s\n", l.Addr())
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
	case err := <-done:
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	shutdown, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := server.Shutdown(shutdown); err != nil {
		t.Error(err)
	}
}
